svg.text: Roof catchment 815 m² (all planes incl. eaves); about 35% (living, master, east) piped to the garden cisterns, the rest
to swales. Rainfall about 1,207 mm/yr, ~88% May-Oct (monsoon). Runoff factor 0.8 (metal roof, first flush). Dry-season
(Nov-Apr) drip demand 142 m³ for the vegetable garden (49 m²), 4 maples, 7 orchard trees and ~120 m² planting.
ROUGH THB (INCL. GUTTERS, FF, PUMP, DRIP)
Selected: 80 m³ = T-1 + T-2 (2 x 19 m³, utility yard) + buried T-3 (42 m³ crate tank). Covers about 75% of dry-season
irrigation; the balance (Jan-Apr) is topped up from the well through an air gap, controlled by tank level + soil
Gutters on every low eave with leaf
Overflow to a planted swale + soakaway
down-slope, away from the drain field.
